facts.fact: According to the page, the value of residential construction projects in the U.S. has followed a strong upward trend for nearly a decade and has recently eclipsed half a trillion dollars.
facts.quote: The value of residential construction projects in the U.S. has followed a strong upward trend for nearly a decade, recently eclipsing half a trillion dollars.

facts.fact: The page says the U.S. construction industry was more or less crippled by the 2008 recession, and private construction spending has grown since its low point in 2010-2011.
facts.quote: private spending has exploded since its low-point in 2010-2011
